content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are having a great day. I am writing to propose a minor adjustment to the agreement before we sign. - Regarding the clause stating that the first installment will be due thirty (30) days following the Effective Date and the second installment will be due sixty (60) days following the Effective Date, the current timing delays funds beyond the standard thirty-day window. I propose the following modification: The first installment will be due thirty (30) days following the Effective Date and the second installment will be due thirty (30) days following the first installment. Please let me know if this adjustment is acceptable so we can proceed. Best regards,
